svg.title: SkyPilot, Kueue and DSX: admission, attribution and logical job status

g.text: SkyPilot, Kueue and DSX: admission, attribution and logical job status
Kubernetes control plane and node runtime
Each observer reads independently. This diagram shows one explanatory execution.
Watch delivery, reads and scrapes have no shared ordering or atomic snapshot.
B. Create two bare Pods; CPU quota is zero
Both Pods use one group, train-a. Names and UIDs here are illustrative.
The lab ClusterQueue starts with nominal CPU quota 0.
C. Pending Pods already have DSX identity
Pod attribution does not wait for admission, scheduling, or application start.
Adding labels changes query grouping. The DSX workload UID remains the Pod UID.
D. Raise CPU quota to 12; Kueue admits the group
Admission permits scheduling. It does not itself prove Running.
The quota values and both gate types were observed in the lab.
E. A SkyPilot job succeeds while its Pods remain Running
The cluster Pods continue Running after this job succeeds.
SkyPilot job status, Pod phase and Kueue Finished are distinct observations.
F. Join labels and Kueue conditions without changing roots
The label join is current-state grouping by name, not immutable association.
Preserve cluster and namespace. Condition reason is not SkyPilot job status.
G. Optional reverse UID association: tested lab adapter
[Separate read-only UID adapter, not shipping DSX]
[Exactly one Workload matches the live Pod UID]
This association is a separate metric. No ownerReferences are edited.
Existing DSX Pod roots and metrics remain unchanged.
H. Optional logical job association: proposed integration
[Proposed Sky API reader; not implemented in DSX]
Direct Sky API reads were tested. This integrated reader is a proposal.
Two concurrent jobs sharing a Pod cannot split that Pod's resource usage.
I. Failed adapter reads clear only adapter associations
[UID adapter receives a denied or failed Kubernetes read]
Failure is local to the optional adapter. It must not suppress DSX Pod metrics.
A later complete successful poll rebuilds the adapter snapshot.
J. Delete a Pod; remove its current series
[UID adapter completes its next successful poll]
Prometheus retains historical samples. Current exporter series disappear.
A replacement Pod with the same name has a different UID and must be matched again.
Actual lab behavior is shown outside the proposed Sky API reader branch.
The UID adapter is a tested lab prototype, not shipping DSX functionality.
